title.en: Insurers claim AI is already increasing healthcare costs
title.zh: 保险公司声称人工智能已经在增加医疗保健成本

summary.en: Blue Cross Blue Shield says hospital use of AI tools led to an additional $942M in healthcare spending over a two-year period.
summary.zh: Blue Cross Blue Shield表示，医院使用人工智能工具导致两年内医疗支出增加了9.42亿美元$。

title.en: OpenAI pauses training of its ‘most capable models’
title.zh: OpenAI暂停对其“最有能力模型”的培训

title.en: I created an interactive digital avatar of myself — and you can talk to it
title.zh: 我创建了一个自己的交互式数字头像—您可以与之交谈

summary.en: After obtaining an interactive avatar and training it to discuss venture fraud, I have mixed feelings about making AI clones of ourselves.
summary.zh: 在获得了一个交互式头像并训练它来讨论风险欺诈之后，我对自己制作人工智能克隆的感觉很复杂。

title.en: AI was supposed to hit new grads hard. So far, unemployment data says otherwise.
title.zh: 人工智能应该对新毕业生造成严重打击。到目前为止，失业数据表明并非如此。

summary.en: "There is no evidence of any significant, widespread displacement or reduction in hiring.”
summary.zh: “没有证据表明有任何重大的、广泛的人员流离失所或招聘人数减少。”

title.en: Proaction boosts sales 60% and saves 75+ hours with Codex

summary.zh: 借助Codex、GPT-Live-1和GPT-6 Astra ， Proaction可以更快地构建、运营和销售现代车队管理。

title.en: Microsoft stops insisting you need a "Copilot+ PC"
title.zh: 微软不再坚持您需要“Copilot + PC”

summary.en: Microsoft's new Surface laptops forgo Copilot+ PC branding.
summary.zh: 微软的新款Surface笔记本电脑放弃了Copilot + PC品牌。
